COSMIC_SKIN.readoutFace is {Bitcount Grid Double, gold, 16, portrait 12}: 10395:4823 / 4829 / 4836 at 16px on grad-gold, 10407:13319 at 12px, which is exactly what the engine already drew. Nothing about this bar changed; it is now a declaration rather than a default the other four games silently inherited. THE ROW IS PARTIAL ANYWAY, and this is the finding the ruling turned up: Bitcount Grid Double has never been fetched. index.html asks Google Fonts for Cormorant Garamond, Manrope, Mulish and JetBrains Mono, skai-ui/src/styles/base.css:34 @imports the same four, and no @font-face for any engine face exists anywhere in the tree. So these readouts have always drawn the stack's next entry, DM Mono if the machine has it and Courier New otherwise, and the same holds for Chango on every win caption and tier label and Bitcount Single on the load screen. The reference face was as absent as the four the ruling added. Measured by grep across src, modules/skai-gaming/src, modules/skai-ui/src, index.html and every css file; no browser ran.

Starbound HUD, and the row the finding was worth chasing for. COSMIC_SKIN.readoutFace {Bitcount Grid Double, gold, 16, portrait 12} - 10395:4823 / 4829 / 4836 at 16 on grad-gold, 10407:13319 at 12 - is what the engine already drew, so nothing about this bar changed and the declaration became a declaration rather than a default four other games inherited. Wave 46 still left it partial, and correctly: the REFERENCE family had never been fetched either, so Starbound's own readouts had always drawn the stack's next entry, and the same held for Chango on every win caption and tier label and Bitcount Single on the load screen. Re-measured 2026-09-17 (wave48-play-slots, 7e1c9b4f) and the wave 46 residual is CLOSED, though not by the thing that was expected to close it. index.html does now link all six display families, and that was necessary and not sufficient: a linked Google Fonts stylesheet DECLARES an @font-face, and the browser fetches the file only when a RENDERED ELEMENT asks for the family. Phaser draws this bar on a canvas, and a canvas pulls no webfont, so the readouts still resolved the stack's next entry on a cold load. slots/engine/fonts.ts now asks document.fonts for the four kind-stack families plus the running skin's face, inside the same Promise.all as the engine's dynamic imports and raced against a 1200ms deadline, BEFORE the game is constructed - a Phaser Text renders once and keeps its bitmap, so a face that lands after a readout is drawn never reaches the player. Nothing blocks on it; a face that misses the window falls through the CSS stack. fonts.test.ts pins both ends, including that index.html links every family the engine names. No browser ran. The load asks for the four kind-stack families on EVERY game, not only the running skin's face, which is what closes this row at both boards; the portrait 12 is the size the engine drew and the node writes, and it now draws in the family the node writes it in.
